information:
This competition will be taking place inside a Hindu Temple. No outside food is to be brought onto the premises. Lunch and snacks will be provided, see Food tab for more information.

New competitors should plan to arrive before 8:15 to ensure you do not miss the competitor tutorial.

Due to payment errors, registration has been pushed back and will open **Friday, June 28 at 8PM EDT**
